decision_summary: Compare skew-restricted search against EV004 at the same length, seed and evaluation budget. Treat EV004 as an unrestricted mixed baseline, since its effective skew fraction was 0.5; defer policy freezing until comparative evidence is available.
expected_information: Verified energy and imbalance under skew restriction, compared with EV004's E=75 and b=7. This informs search allocation without establishing optimality or general method superiority.
